end.summary:
Riya understood examples of diversity in language, food, dress and festivals across Indian regions, including Tamil, idli and mekhela chador.
Riya practised explaining “unity in diversity” and “many in the one”; the meaning and why diversity enriches society still need checking.
Riya continued to say that diversity causes fights and that everyone being the same would bring peace; this was not corrected by the last turn.
Riya gave the image of different flowers held together by one thread, but still interpreted the differences as preventing the garland from forming.
end.parentNote: Asha practised regional examples with Riya, and Riya gave examples such as Tamil, idli and mekhela chador. Riya also explored the flower-and-thread image, but the mix-up that diversity causes division and that unity means sameness was still present at the end. At home, ask Riya to name two different festivals or foods and complete: “They are different, but unity means we can ___ together.”
